name: get_forecast
description: Returns daily forecast data (high/low temperatures, sunrise, sunset, precipitation, weather code) for a configurable range of future days

from_day.description: Start of the forecast range as an offset from today. 0 means today, 1 means tomorrow, 2 means the day after tomorrow, etc. Defaults to 1 (tomorrow). Clamped to 0–6.

to_day.description: End of the forecast range (inclusive) as an offset from today. 0 means today, 1 means tomorrow, etc. Defaults to 6 (six days from today). Must be >= from_day. Clamped to 0–6.
